crossRefs.note: “Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one…
Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
in that day I swore to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them…
Moreover also I swore to them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them…

parallels.note: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite…
If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and…
and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.

translations.web: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translations.bsb: And He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
translations.kjv: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.
translations.asv: and he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.
